findings.scenario: Public facade reads always use ArmorGpu.context while accepting supplied Buffer(s). Lower Buffer::read requires exact creating device, paired queue and mapping ownership. Current facade direct-read docs mention submission/progress/external mapping but do not state the complete provenance precondition; async/grouped methods do not state it explicitly. SDK Buffer has no public device/map-state query.
findings.agreed_disposition: Root explicitly agreed to document existing device/paired-queue preconditions on direct read/read_async and grouped read/read_staged_async. Direct reads reference Buffer::read mapping contract; grouped sources must be available for actual GPU copies under existing mapping ownership. No invented exclusive-read or alias guarantee.
findings.repair: Documentation only in facade.rs and staging.rs; no new validator, metadata owner, compatibility API, type or implementation change. Preserve producing-submit result handling, all current progress policies and actual cause retention.
findings.acceptance: All four public methods clearly state the relevant native provenance contract; direct methods link Buffer::read mapping requirements; grouped methods describe copy availability without granting stronger alias exclusion. Every body, signature, native command, fixture and shader remains byte-identical.
findings.status: inventoried before edit; repair pending Root
